ns2:section.sectionText: **RESTRICTION INFO: https://go.economics.illinois.edu/SpringRestrictions **DESCRIPTION: This course develops analytical tools to employ economic modeling and data to make better strategic decisions. The objective of this course is to foster data-driven critical-thinking skills through econometric analyses and statistical interpretation.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Economics or Econometrics & Quant Econ or Computer Science & Economics major(s) or minor(s). Restricted to Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign.
